INSERT INTO company_bid_notice_state ( company_id, bid_notice_id, notice_status, first_seen_run_id, last_seen_run_id, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES
( #{companyId}, #{bidNoticeId}, 'COLLECTED', #{runId}, #{runId}, #{observedAt}, #{observedAt}, #{observedAt}, NULL )
AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE first_seen_run_id = IF( incoming.first_seen_at < first_seen_at, incoming.first_seen_run_id, first_seen_run_id ), first_seen_at = LEAST(first_seen_at, incoming.first_seen_at), last_seen_run_id = IF( incoming.last_seen_at > last_seen_at, incoming.last_seen_run_id, last_seen_run_id ), last_seen_at = GREATEST(last_seen_at, incoming.last_seen_at), updated_at = GREATEST(last_seen_at, incoming.last_seen_at)
